title: Strange restaurant drive-thru location that I sometimes order food from at night
content: Has anyone been here in Mallworld or at least somewhere resembling it? Bonus points if you’ve seen some kind of restaurant/convenience store/food stand nearby. I know this kind of post is everywhere, but this image in particular feels like it truly resonates with me. It of course doesn’t look the exact same as the real thing, and it’s not even a restaurant to my knowledge, but it still encapsulates the vibe PERFECTLY.
